speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned you are presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; can you tell me how many days old you are and when these symptoms first began?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus.

The history of bilious vomiting in a newborn, combined with a family history of pyloric stenosis and a missed prenatal checkup, strongly suggests this life-threatening emergency. I am requesting an Urgent Abdominal Ultrasound and a STAT Upper GI Series to confirm the diagnosis immediately.
